time.frequency_canonicalization: divide numerator and denominator by gcd
time.ceil_edge: smallest cycle n for which edge_time(n) >= arrival_time; an arrival exactly on an edge uses that edge
time.synchronization_cycles: capture edge index plus N receiver cycles
time.checkpoint_restore: recompute fractional_remainder from canonical clock fields and reject mismatch

event_order.string_encoding: UTF-8 NFC normalized bytes compared unsigned lexicographically

cdc.zero_latency_cycles: reject unless a queue or clock edge produces strict state/time progress
cdc.bridge_request_path_progress: forward_latency_fs > 0 or receiver_sync_cycles > 0, including cross-domain bridges
cdc.zeno_detection: fail after a configurable finite same-time event budget with a dependency-cycle diagnostic

alignment.rational_floor: mathematical floor including negative intermediate values
alignment.piecewise_segments: strictly increasing, non-overlapping, left-closed and right-open except final right-closed segment
alignment.boundary_discontinuity: allowed only when explicitly declared and never CYCLE_GRADE across the boundary

routing.source_scores: exact decimal expansion of the declared source dtype value
routing.absolute_tolerance: exactly four ULP at the source-dtype kth boundary
routing.tolerance_change: Phase 1 may only tighten before formal execution

legacy.p6: historical meaning retained; new offline stage is V0
